output_text:
from google.cloud import aiplatform
from google.protobuf import json_format
from google.protobuf.struct_pb2 import Value

def invoke_platform_model(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    project = config.get("project") or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT")
    location = config.get("location", "us-central1")
    endpoint_id = config.get("endpoint_id")

    if not all([project, location, endpoint_id]):
        raise ValueError("Project, location, and endpoint_id must be provided in config or environment variables.")

    api_endpoint = f"{location}-aiplatform.googleapis.com"
    client_options = {"api_endpoint": api_endpoint}
    
    # Initialize client
    client = aiplatform.gapic.PredictionServiceClient(client_options=client_options)
    
    # The full endpoint resource name.
    endpoint_path = client.endpoint_path(
        project=project, location=location, endpoint=endpoint_id
    )
    
    # The payload is expected to be a list of instances (dicts)
    instances = [json_format.ParseDict(instance, Value()) for instance in payload]
    
    response = client.predict(endpoint=endpoint_path, instances=instances)
    result = [json_format.MessageToDict(p) for p in response.predictions]
    return result
